decision_value: Predictions P3 and P4 and the 4,096-column +counted factor of the frozen protocol are decided only here. If pin-wiedemann ties structured-gauss's S within 5 percent (the preregistered prediction) the pin solver is closed as no end-to-end gain and effort moves to the genus-3 matrices; if its S is below structured-gauss's at every §5a band weight on the F(p^4) rows it is an improvement and lands on the leaderboard validated.

question: Does a sparse relation matrix that stops at the target pin (pin-wiedemann), or the +counted accounting of the deferred solvers, change end-to-end S on the F(p^4) ladder or the 30-bit prime scaling set?

resources.notes: S2 (366 runs) took about 45 minutes in the previous study at isolation L0; S1 is 10 runs of about 220 s; each session is then replayed in full (--replay-all) at about the same cost. README.md of the study has the derivation.
